rule_definition.name: Identity Validation Required Before Any Scan Result Is Trusted

rule_text: No scan result, readiness classification, delta review, recommendation, or certification action shall be considered valid for any item unless that item has passed Gate -1 identity validation (PG-011). Identity validation confirms: (a) QID format matches the expected pack regex, (b) CorrectChoice is present and valid (A/B/C/D), (c) Stem is present and non-empty, (d) ExplanationCorrect is present and non-empty, (e) pack attribution is correct (no cross-pack QID leakage), and (f) no cross-pack QID collisions exist. Items failing identity validation are classified BLOCKED and excluded from all downstream processing.

enforcement.mechanism: Gate -1 (PG-011) is the first gate in the scan pipeline. It executes before all other gates. The Scan Orchestrator (S322 Script 3) checks Gate -1 results before proceeding to Gate 0. If Gate -1 produces BLOCKED items, the orchestrator logs identity blocks and continues processing only identity-valid items.
enforcement.technical_implementation: identity_validator.js (S322 Script 1) runs 9 checks (PRE-N1 through GV-N1-08) across all 2,540 items. BLOCKED items are logged in the scan artifact's perItemResults section with identity_block: true. All downstream consumers check identity_block before processing.
enforcement.violation_consequence: If a board consumes a scan result for an identity-blocked item, the downstream action is void. The item must be re-validated by Gate -1 before any further processing. Identity-blocked items must not appear in readiness classifications, recommendations, or certification queues.

evidence_basis.v1_problem: S320 remediation targeted items by QID alone — 'P1-E-037: fix DL-025 EW slot.' But Pack A Section E uses a 5-item rotation group. QID-alone targeting grabbed the wrong variant (same QID prefix, different rotation position). The correct item was never fixed. The wrong item was modified.
evidence_basis.v2_solution: Gate -1 validates QID format, CC presence, Stem presence, EC presence, and pack attribution before any scan result is produced. Items with invalid QID formats (P1-E-Rxx in Pack E), missing CorrectChoice (P1-E-R33), or cross-pack QID leakage are BLOCKED. Compound-key identity prevents variant targeting failures.
evidence_basis.s204_validation: S204 Board B validated Gate -1 against all 5 packs: 2,539 PASS, 1 BLOCKED (P1-E-R33 — missing CC/Stem/EC). 40 items flagged with non-standard QID format (P1-E-R01 through P1-E-R40). Gate -1 correctly identified all identity anomalies. The Pack E regex was updated to accept P1-E-R\d{2}$.

PRE_N1_QID_FORMAT.description: QID matches expected regex per pack
PRE_N1_QID_FORMAT.s204_result: 2,500/2,540 standard format. 40 supplementary P1-E-R items identified. Regex updated in S205.

GV_N1_01_CORRECTCHOICE_PRESENT.description: CorrectChoice field exists and equals A/B/C/D

GV_N1_02_STEM_PRESENT.description: Stem field exists and is non-empty

GV_N1_03_EXPLANATIONCORRECT_PRESENT.description: ExplanationCorrect field exists and is non-empty

GV_N1_04_PACK_ATTRIBUTION.description: QID prefix matches containing pack file

GV_N1_05_CROSS_PACK_COLLISION.description: No QID appears in more than one pack file
GV_N1_05_CROSS_PACK_COLLISION.s204_result: 2,540/2,540 PASS. Zero collisions. Note: P1-E-xxx (Pack A Section E) vs P1E-xxx (Pack E) are distinct by hyphen position — DL-033 naming convention confirmed.

GV_N1_06_CORRECTCHOICE_VALID.description: CorrectChoice is exactly one of A/B/C/D

GV_N1_07_QID_UNIQUE_IN_PACK.description: No duplicate QIDs within a pack
GV_N1_07_QID_UNIQUE_IN_PACK.s204_result: 2,540/2,540 PASS. All QIDs unique within their packs.

GV_N1_08_QUESTION_STATE_PRESENT.description: question_state field exists (not required, but flagged if absent)
GV_N1_08_QUESTION_STATE_PRESENT.s204_result: 2,540/2,540 have question_state. (DL-024 Pack B Sections A/D fixed in prior session.)

interaction_with_other_rules.R6 (READY Required): R7 is a prerequisite — R6's readiness classifications are only valid for R7-passing items. Identity-blocked items never receive a readiness classification.
interaction_with_other_rules.R8 (Scan Once): R7 is the first scan in the R8 pipeline. The scan artifact's perItemResults section carries identity_block flags. All boards consuming the artifact check this flag.
interaction_with_other_rules.Governance Guard R2: R2 (EW[CC] empty) is a Gate 1 structural check — it operates on identity-valid items only. An identity-blocked item could carry DL-008, but the pipeline never reaches Gate 1 for that item.

s320_failure_modes: QID-only targeting — wrong rotation variant selected
Cross-pack QID confusion — P1-E-037 in Pack A vs P1E-037 in Pack E
Missing CC — remediation script writes to wrong ExplanationWrong slot
s320_prevention.r7_prevention: All three failure modes are blocked by Gate -1: (1) compound-key identity resolves which variant is being targeted, (2) pack attribution check catches P1-E-xxx vs P1E-xxx confusion, (3) missing CC is blocked before any downstream script executes.

activation_conditions.verdict: RULE 7 ACTIVATED — Gate -1 identity validation is mandatory for all Framework v2 operations.
